Digital Experience & AI Agents

Give AI Agents a Job They Can Safely Finish

Connect AI agents to trusted content and business workflows while keeping people in control of consequential decisions.

A customer asks whether a delivery address can be changed. A generic answer sends them back through the help centre. An agent integrated with the customer experience can check the order status, retrieve the relevant policy and explain the next step. The quality of that interaction depends on the content, permissions and workflow behind it.

Start with one job and a trusted source

Choose a frequent request with a clear completion point, such as checking whether a dispatch address can still be changed. Maintain the policy in the content platform with an owner, effective date and regional scope. Give the agent access to the current approved version and the minimum order details required for the decision. If the policy is missing or the order status is unclear, hand off to support with the context already gathered.

Separate advice from action

Let the agent explain eligibility using read-only access. Handle the address change through a separate tool that checks identity, authorisation and the latest order status. Show the customer the proposed update and ask for confirmation before submitting it. If the order has moved to dispatch in the meantime, the tool should reject the change and return a clear next step. Record the decision and action so a support colleague can reconstruct what happened. Treat retrieved content as untrusted input: instructions in a document must not change tool permissions or approval rules. Enforce those controls in the application, outside the model.

Evaluate the journey as a service

Build a test set that includes routine requests, regional policy differences, stale content, unavailable systems and attempts to access another customer’s order. Measure whether answers follow approved policy, whether eligible requests reach completion and whether uncertain cases reach the right team. Check repeat contacts alongside completion rates. A customer who has to ask again may expose a gap that a successful tool call would miss.

Integrate where customers already work

Connect approved content from Adobe Experience Cloud or another content platform to the portal and support workflows already in use. Start with one channel, review the outcomes with content and operations teams, then expand where the same rules apply. NEWRONIQ combines Digital Experience Engineering with AI, Data & Intelligent Automation to connect content, customer context and controlled business actions.
